profiles.name: Jonathan Yasin
profiles.description: Jonathan Yasin represents Ranau, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS).
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current GRS coalition label is retained. Service addresses, event attendance and earlier Bersatu membership are not used to assign a current component party. No court judgment is converted into a delivery milestone.

profiles.name: Jeffrey Kitingan
profiles.position: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of STAR
profiles.description: Jeffrey Kitingan represents Keningau, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of STAR. Affiliated with STAR. STAR is separate from GRS following its October 2025 exit.

profile_sources.label: STAR · current president and separate Sabah government support, 16 April 2026

profiles.affiliation_note: STAR’s October 2025 departure from GRS supersedes Parliament’s retained GRS party label. The party is a separate government-supporting organisation, not a current GRS component. State support and federal classification are distinct.

profiles.name: Riduan Rubin
profiles.description: Riduan Rubin represents Tenom, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. An independent MP supporting the federal government. KDM affiliation is reported separately; Parliament retains the independent label.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament lists BEBAS. An August article counts him among KDM’s two MPs, while other reporting calls him independent. The conservative parliamentary independent label is retained under government support; formal party membership is left unresolved.

milestones.title: Continue the reported support for bedridden Hospital Ranau patients
milestones.description: Jonathan’s constituency welfare report states that its free-treatment support initiative for bedridden hospital patients remained active.
milestones.progress_note: A January activity report, not a verified entitlement for every patient. No independently audited beneficiary count, expenditure total, completion target or later continuation record was established.

milestones.title: Deliver food and essentials to Tenom flood-relief centres
milestones.description: Riduan’s team reported initial deliveries to Melalap and Kemabong relief centres, with partner agencies and youth volunteers, plus water supplies for Kuala Tomani frontline services.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the reported initial relief deliveries. It does not claim all affected families were served, that flooding ended or that the MP alone delivered the response.

party_parents_added.name: Parti Solidariti Tanah Airku
party_parents_added.description: A separate government-supporting Sabah party. It left GRS in October 2025 and is not presented as a current GRS component.
